rationale: Professional developers on paid Claude Code plans (≥$100/mo) report 529 errors disrupting daily workflows, with multiple HN and Reddit threads confirming the problem is widespread and ongoing. Willingness-to-pay is evidenced by the existence and pricing of competing managed services (Portkey, OpenRouter, LiteLLM Cloud), all charging $20–$500/mo for reliability and routing features. The target segment is clearly defined and budget-holding, though evidence volume sits just at the threshold — 5 distinct pain signals identified across public forums.
